exposure: known and potential risk factors extracted from electronic medical records prior to delivery
red blood cell indices upon admission
cohort: The study utilized a delivery cohort of 70,948 participants from which 6,639 PPH deliveries were identified.
finding: The developed 24-feature gradient boosting model achieved an AUROC of 0.71 for predicting PPH, outperforming other clinical and research-based tools, and identified novel risk factors and clinical feature thresholds.
